_comment: Permission policy for Claude Code agents. Two tiers: 'allow' = unguarded, 'ask' = human approval required. Replace project-specific paths (TODO comments) before committing. See standards.md §10.

ask._comment_project_specific: Append project-specific critical paths below. Examples: HTTP API contract (lib/api.ts, frontend/src/lib/api.ts), auth state machines (contexts/AuthContext.tsx, backend/src/lib/auth/**), backend routes (backend/src/routes/**), generated/release artifacts (android/**, prisma/migrations/**), real-API E2E contract tests (e2e/**, backend/test/e2e/real/**, frontend/tests/e2e-real/**), publish/build orchestration scripts (scripts/build-apk.sh, scripts/publish-apk.sh, scripts/ship.sh), test config (jest.config.cjs, vitest.config.ts, playwright.config.ts).
